items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I got a call from Art Baron that he recommended me for a Wynton Marsalis Lincoln Center concert

ctx.x: Cool. My goodness. Wynton Marsalis you’ve played behind?

Yes. Once. Yeah it was wonderful. I was so nervous. I got a call from Art Baron that he recommended me for a Wynton Marsalis Lincoln Center concert because they were doing the music of Gerry Mulligan. And I was to play tuba and bass trombone. So I went and I went into Carroll Studios with the tuba and the bass bone and I just sat there very quietly and Wynton came in and there was sort of a lull so I went up to him and I said, “Excuse me” I said “my name is Alan Raph,” and the next thing I know he’s hugging me.…
Do you make an effort to get copies of the recordings you play on?
